Right page: a narrow strip at the right edge with partial index entries (margin of the adjoining page, mostly cut off), treated as a column of text. No notes below the text.

page.notes: The right-hand strip (partly visible index of the next page, entries beginning Ge-, Gl-, Gr-, Gu- etc., with page numbers such as 514, 175, 443) is cut off at the scan edge and is not transcribed in full. Several numbers in the left column are uncertain from the scan (e.g. 'Fœdus 389,390', 'Fora 186,247', 'Fures an suspendendi 284'). The catchword "Geleite" at the foot right is in the margin of the right column and may be a catchword. The left-hand gutter shows show-through and is not transcribed.
